subject.title: test(browser): replace broad win32 skip with dynamic directory symlink check

question: Should this test-only PR merge with focused terminal proof, or should maintainers require native Windows output for the browser directory-junction path first?
rationale: The code path is narrow and current checks are green, but Linux-focused CI does not prove the Windows junction execution path that motivated the change.

options.title: Merge After Green Checks
options.body: Accept the low test-harness risk because the patch is scoped to one test and the current head has no blocking code finding.

options.title: Request Native Windows Proof
options.body: Ask for a native Windows focused run of `extensions/browser/src/browser/output-directories.test.ts` showing the symlink ancestor case runs or skips for the expected capability reason.

recommendation.title: Merge After Green Checks
recommendation.body: Accept the low test-harness risk because the patch is scoped to one test and the current head has no blocking code finding.
